message.content:
Here’s the updated list of functions you can call from the ticketing and file‑system toolkits:

---

## Ticketing System Functions

| Function | Purpose | Parameters |
|----------|---------|------------|
| **`ticket_login`** | Authenticate a user for the ticket system. | `username` (string), `password` (string) |
| **`ticket_get_login_status`** | Get the login status of the currently authenticated user. | None |
| **`logout`** | Log out the current user. | None |
| **`create_ticket`** | Create a ticket in the system and queue it. | `title` (string), `description` (string, optional, default `""`), `priority` (number, optional, default `1`) |
| **`edit_ticket`** | Modify the details of an existing ticket. | `ticket_id` (number), `updates` (dict with optional `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`) |
| **`get_ticket`** | Get a specific ticket by its ID. | `ticket_id` (number) |
| **`get_user_tickets`** | Get all tickets created by the current user, optionally filtered by status. | `status` (string, optional, default `"None"`) |
| **`resolve_ticket`** | Resolve a ticket with a resolution. | `ticket_id` (number), `resolution` (string) |
| **`close_ticket`** | Close a ticket. | `ticket_id` (number) |

---

## Gorilla File System Functions

| Function | Purpose | Parameters |
|----------|---------|------------|
| **`cd`** | Change the current working directory to the specified folder. | `folder` (string) |
| **`pwd`** | Return the current working directory path. | None |
| **`ls`** | List the contents of the current directory. | `a` (bool, optional, default `False`) |
| **`mkdir`** | Create a new directory in the current directory. | `dir_name` (string) |
| **`rmdir`** | Remove a directory at current directory. | `dir_name` (string) |
| **`rm`** | Remove a file or directory. | `file_name` (string) |
